## Weekly AI tool changes digest by email
Every Monday this reads the free AI Leakage changes feed and emails one short list of the week's checked changes to AI vendors' terms, privacy pages and pricing. Handy for a team, or for an IT provider sending clients a weekly note.

**Set up (2 minutes)**
1. In **Your settings**, set who it goes to, and optionally list tools (names or slugs, commas). Empty means every tool.
2. In **Send the digest**, add your SMTP credential and your From address (or swap in a Gmail or Outlook node).
3. Activate. A week with no changes sends nothing.

Feed: CC BY 4.0, please keep the link back. General information, not legal advice.
